label: TP
reason: The parameter from request.getParameterValues directly flows into the cookie's name attribute via new javax.servlet.http.Cookie("SomeCookie", str). The cookie name becomes part of the HTTP response headers. While the cookie value is sanitized with encodeForHTML, the cookie name itself is not sanitized and can contain arbitrary characters including CRLF sequences, enabling HTTP Response Splitting.

evidence.note: User input 'param' is used as the second argument (cookie name) in new Cookie()
Cookie object is added to response, making the unsanitized cookie name part of the HTTP response
